title: Year-End Financial Checklist for Contractors 2025
summary: If you've got uncashed checks in your truck, receipts in your glovebox, and your accountant's already texting about year-end while your QuickBooks hasn't been reconciled since September, this checklist is for you. This year-end financial guide helps construction contractors wrap up 2025 efficiently by reconciling accounts and collecting outstanding invoices, maximizing tax deductions before December 31st with Section 179 ($1.25M limit) and 40% bonus depreciation, preparing 1099s for the January 31st, 2026 deadline, reviewing banking infrastructure costs, and planning 2026 cash flow with clear financial goals. The guide includes specific deadlines and an action plan so you can close out the year strong without spending your entire holiday season buried in paperwork.
